Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 1264 of 2024
Applicant :- Sonia Garg

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Himanshu Bansal,Shivam Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manoj Bajaj,J.
Applicants have approached this Court through this application under Section 483 Code of Criminal Procedure for issuance of directions to the Judicial Magistrate-7, Meerut to expedite and conclude the proceedings of Criminal Case No.15954 of 2019, titled State Vs. Praful and others, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and under Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police Station Brahmpuri, District Meerut in a stipulated period.

A perusal of the zimni orders would reveal that the prosecution launched by the applicant- complainant was challenged by the accused- applicant through application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No.10346 of 2020, wherein interim order in favour accused- applicant was passed on 26th August, 2020 and later it was again reiterated in March, 2022.
Thus, the delay in adjudication of the proceedings cannot be attributed to the accused.
No exceptional ground is made out for issuing the directions for expeditious disposal of the trial.
The application fails and is hereby dismissed.
